O.outcome_detail: Correct responses to open-ended QMAT Q6

cells.quote: The overall average correct response to the open-ended question was 37% [(a) 44%, (b) 39%, (C) 28%] at CPP (N=19) and 54% [(a) 66%, (b) 59%, (C) 38%] at CUB (N=53).
cells.note: CPP had a lower average correct-response rate than CUB; no effect size was printed.

O.outcome_detail: Scores on the first 28-question multiple-choice assessment

cells.quote: The average scores for individual questions were strikingly similar for CPP and CUB, suggesting that the relative item difficulty of the MC test for students from different populations is similar (Fig. 1). The mean scores for the two institutions were comparable but very low, indicating that the test is challenging.
cells.note: The study describes the scores as similar/comparable but reports no significance test, power analysis, or effect size.

O.outcome_detail: Item difficulty on multiple-choice questions about time variation of position probability density

cells.quote: While the item difficulty of MC-Q16 is in an ideal range (~50% correct), MC-Q17 is overly challenging for the students.
cells.note: This is an item-level contrast rather than a randomized instructional comparison.
